(i) the agent-based architecture is a good solution for presenting interactive timed media to networked devices, because it allows separating the presentation aspect from the control aspect; (ii) the architecture allows mapping the same document to the different environments; (iii) the architecture allows the automatic registration of the PAC agents to the environment.
we have developed an architecture that enables the creation and distribution of interactive timed media.
the proposed agent-based architecture is a flexible solution for distributed interfaces and interactive timed media in storytelling applications.

the following issues: (1) the design and implementation of a distributed architecture for the presentation of interactive multimedia documents; (2) the use of agents to separate the presentation aspects from control aspects; (3) the use of the PAC model to provide the necessary flexibility and reactivity for the system.

this architecture provides a framework for the development of interactive storytelling applications.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have designed and developed an architecture and an implementation for the presentation and control of distributed interactive media, and have tested this architecture in a storytelling environment.
the architecture allows the creation of a distributed and networked environment that is able to provide the same content to different devices, with different interfaces, and with different media.
we have developed an agent-based architecture, called the PAC agent architecture, for distributed interfaces and interactive media.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use a single document to generate different presentations, each one adapted to a different device.
a storytelling application can be presented in a network of heterogeneous devices by using a set of PAC agents that can be dynamically registered and removed.
the use of a hierarchical structure for the PAC agents allows us to separate the presentation aspects from control aspects, and to automatically adapt the same document to the different devices.
